name: ELMPay SOTA full-coverage test matrix
purpose: Executable local/CI verification plan for every B00-B127 skill batch. Matrix coverage is not certification evidence.

coverage.completeness_gate: every manifest batch is covered by exactly one suite

suites.name: Governance, SSOT, traceability and evidence controls

scenarios.steps: Load the manifest, registry, requirements, controls and threat model; compare generated documents.
scenarios.expected: No duplicate IDs, dangling references, generated drift or governance problems.

scenarios.steps: Corrupt a disposable copy of a required rule and run the validator CLI.
scenarios.expected: The CLI exits non-zero and names the exact rule; no warning-only success.

scenarios.steps: Inspect evidence writer paths and current B00 files.
scenarios.expected: This runner writes no evidence/completion/review files and leaves B00 untouched.

suites.name: Money, domain model, state machine and API contracts

scenarios.steps: Generate boundary amounts for every supported currency and round-trip through serialization.
scenarios.expected: No float/exponent acceptance; scale and rounding are deterministic.

scenarios.steps: Enumerate every payment state transition, including duplicate and illegal transitions.
scenarios.expected: Only declared transitions succeed and illegal transitions fail closed.

scenarios.steps: Validate OpenAPI request, response and error fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Schema validation and compatibility checks pass.

suites.name: Events, ownership, partitioning, migration and topology

scenarios.steps: Publish, retry, consume and replay an event envelope with an Inbox/Outbox fixture.
scenarios.expected: Schema, ordering metadata and deduplication are preserved.

scenarios.steps: Attempt cross-tenant reads/writes and invalid ownership migrations.
scenarios.expected: Isolation and migration guards reject the operation.

scenarios.steps: Render service topology and dependency graph.
scenarios.expected: No forbidden dependency edge or undeclared data owner exists.

suites.name: Zero trust, identity, MFA, authorization, keys, certificates and audit

scenarios.steps: Exercise session expiry, revocation, phishing-resistant MFA and recovery paths.
scenarios.expected: Expired/revoked/weak sessions cannot perform privileged mutations.

scenarios.steps: Evaluate RBAC/ABAC, separation of duties and time-bounded elevation permutations.
scenarios.expected: Default deny, independent approver and least privilege are enforced.

scenarios.steps: Run secret, certificate, baseline and tamper-evident audit fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Hard-coded secrets and tampered audit records are rejected.

suites.name: Tenant, merchant, provider account, capability, routing and onboarding controls

scenarios.steps: Provision two tenants and bind merchant/provider credentials with synthetic IDs.
scenarios.expected: Credentials, capabilities and configuration are tenant-scoped.

scenarios.steps: Resolve routes across region, currency, method, risk and maintenance dimensions.
scenarios.expected: Unsupported combinations fail before provider side effects.

scenarios.steps: Run four-eyes onboarding, fee calculation and isolation probes.
scenarios.expected: Approval, pricing and cross-tenant probes meet policy.

suites.name: Payment intent, attempts, authorization/capture and idempotency

scenarios.steps: Create an intent, authorize, partially capture, cancel and close using deterministic adapters.
scenarios.expected: State transitions, amount bounds and ledger-facing facts are correct.

scenarios.steps: Send duplicate create/capture/refund requests concurrently with the same idempotency key.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one side effect and a stable replay response are observed.

scenarios.steps: Inject timeout, callback-before-response and provider-unknown outcomes.
scenarios.expected: No optimistic success; retry/unknown semantics are explicit and fail closed.

suites.name: Provider webhook ingress, business delivery and read models

scenarios.steps: Replay signed, unsigned, malformed and tenant-mismatched provider callbacks.
scenarios.expected: Signature and binding checks run before state mutation.

scenarios.steps: Deliver duplicate and out-of-order events through Inbox and consumer retry fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Delivery is idempotent, monotonic where required, and poison messages are quarantined.

scenarios.steps: Project read-model state after accepted and rejected events.
scenarios.expected: Queries expose only verified payment facts and stable error contracts.

suites.name: WeChat Pay and Alipay contract, signing and lifecycle tests

scenarios.steps: Generate sandbox requests for JSAPI, Native, H5, App, face-to-face and certificate modes.
scenarios.expected: Canonical fields, signing inputs and capability refusal match contracts.

scenarios.steps: Return provider success, business failure, timeout and malformed notification fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Response parsing preserves UNKNOWN and never treats client display as payment truth.

scenarios.steps: Exercise refund, close, query and bill-download lifecycle vectors.
scenarios.expected: All side effects are idempotent and bounded by intent/attempt state.

suites.name: Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, multi-channel simulators and certification contracts

scenarios.steps: Run PaymentIntent/Order/merchant-session vectors with tokenized synthetic payment methods.
scenarios.expected: Request/response contracts and capability matrix are deterministic.

scenarios.steps: Replay provider webhook, refund, dispute and subscription fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Signature, idempotency, ordering and lifecycle mapping are enforced.

scenarios.steps: Run every local simulator contract and inject unsupported capability combinations.
scenarios.expected: Unsupported combinations fail before network side effects.

suites.name: Hosted checkout, links, session integrity, web UI and SDK compatibility

scenarios.steps: Create hosted checkout/link/QR sessions and tamper with amount, currency, return URL and expiry.
scenarios.expected: Signed sessions reject mutation and expire deterministically.

scenarios.steps: Run web keyboard, locale, fallback and failure-path tests with synthetic intents.
scenarios.expected: No success is inferred from client state; accessibility and localization contracts pass.

scenarios.steps: Execute Node, Python, Go, Java, .NET and mobile SDK contract vectors where toolchains are available.
scenarios.expected: SDKs preserve error/idempotency/unknown semantics across languages.

suites.name: Refund, disputes, subscriptions, mandates, dunning and lifecycle E2E

scenarios.steps: Approve, reject, partially and fully refund an authorized/captured attempt.
scenarios.expected: Approval controls, amount ceilings and idempotent side effects hold.

scenarios.steps: Open/respond/close disputes and run subscription renewal, cancellation and proration vectors.
scenarios.expected: Deadlines, balances and state transitions remain consistent.

scenarios.steps: Expire mandate, trigger dunning and update token references.
scenarios.expected: No raw card data is stored and retries remain bounded.

suites.name: Immutable ledger, posting, fees, settlement, ingestion and reconciliation

scenarios.steps: Post authorization, capture, fee, refund and settlement entries, then replay the same event.
scenarios.expected: Ledger is append-only, balanced and duplicate-safe.

scenarios.steps: Apply tax, fee, currency scale, FX and rounding boundary vectors.
scenarios.expected: Zero unexplained balance delta and deterministic rounding.

scenarios.steps: Ingest provider/bank files with missing, duplicate and mismatched rows.
scenarios.expected: Three-way reconciliation produces explainable exceptions and audit exports.

suites.name: Real-time risk, signals, rule/ML boundaries, phishing and abuse operations

scenarios.steps: Evaluate velocity, device, network, account, denylist and allowlist signal permutations.
scenarios.expected: Decisions are explainable, tenant-scoped and fail closed on missing signals.

scenarios.steps: Version rules and invoke ML scoring with invalid features, NaN and model timeout.
scenarios.expected: Schema/version/finite-value controls reject unsafe scores.

scenarios.steps: Run phishing, e-skimming, bot, credential-stuffing and case-management fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Controls emit actionable signals without leaking sensitive data.

suites.name: Gateway, mesh, database, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, multi-region and recovery

scenarios.steps: Exercise gateway authentication, WAF/rate-limit and mTLS/network-policy fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Unauthenticated, over-limit and unauthorized paths are rejected.

scenarios.steps: Inject database, Kafka, Redis and lock/lease failures into deterministic adapters.
scenarios.expected: Durability, fencing, replay and recovery behavior is explicit.

scenarios.steps: Render digest-pinned workloads and simulate regional failover/write fencing.
scenarios.expected: Policy output is hardened; production K8s/DR remains external evidence, not a local claim.

suites.name: Telemetry, SLO, funnel metrics, SIEM, incidents, channel health and capacity

scenarios.steps: Emit redacted logs, metrics and traces for success, failure and unknown payment outcomes.
scenarios.expected: Correlation fields are present and sensitive values are redacted.

scenarios.steps: Feed SLI/SLO, error-budget, channel-health and capacity samples at threshold boundaries.
scenarios.expected: Alerts, breaker decisions and go/no-go decisions are deterministic.

scenarios.steps: Replay incident, security case, rollback and reconciliation runbook fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Runbooks identify owner, escalation, rollback and evidence outputs.

suites.name: PCI, China/global privacy, AML/KYB, data lifecycle, supply chain and vendor risk

scenarios.steps: Evaluate PCI/data classification/retention/tokenization and regional processing policy fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Out-of-scope claims are rejected; retention and deletion are explicit.

scenarios.steps: Run AML/KYC/KYB/sanctions and privacy boundary cases with synthetic identities.
scenarios.expected: The platform records a boundary decision and never pretends to be a regulated decision maker.

scenarios.steps: Validate SBOM, provenance, signature, dependency, secret and vendor-exit controls.
scenarios.expected: Missing or stale supply-chain artifacts fail closed.

suites.name: Property/model tests, provider contracts, webhook faults and concurrency

scenarios.steps: Run deterministic property/model vectors for money, state, ledger balance, routing, auth and date boundaries.
scenarios.expected: Invariants hold for generated edge values and counterexamples are reproducible.

scenarios.steps: Fuzz webhook payloads and schedule duplicate, delayed, reordered, replayed and clock-skewed deliveries.
scenarios.expected: Only verified events mutate state; no duplicate side effect is observed.

scenarios.steps: Run deterministic concurrency/fault vectors and validate the exact local test-module ownership map.
scenarios.expected: Declared quality tests execute and new testing modules cannot be silently omitted.

suites.name: Executable security orchestration and loopback performance/fault profiles

scenarios.steps: Discover available scanners and execute the SAST/secret/dependency, loopback DAST and IAST-hook orchestration with artifact/digest/exit-code binding.
scenarios.expected: Missing tools or unbound results are FAIL/BLOCKED; synthetic reports cannot self-attest completion.

scenarios.steps: Send bounded concurrent traffic only to a TEST-token-protected loopback HTTP service and measure peak, burst and soak outcomes.
scenarios.expected: Measured throughput, errors, latency and duplicate results meet the declared thresholds; live or non-loopback targets are rejected.

scenarios.steps: Execute load/soak/queue/DB/provider fault profiles and measure recovery behavior.
scenarios.expected: Recovery metrics are derived from executed probes and unsafe/unknown outcomes fail closed.

suites.name: UAT, finance/operations acceptance and independently reviewed evidence
suites.blocking_evidence: BLOCKED: signed UAT/finance/operations acceptance and Git-tracked independent review.json are required; local tests cannot self-approve them.

scenarios.steps: Execute a representative merchant order-to-settlement journey in an approved UAT environment.
scenarios.expected: Business owner signs acceptance with run ID, scope and zero open critical findings.

scenarios.steps: Reconcile finance, support and operations outputs against independent source records.
scenarios.expected: Signed reconciliation and support acceptance artifacts are bound to the release.

scenarios.steps: Independent reviewer verifies code, command, artifact and digest bindings.
scenarios.expected: review.json is Git-tracked, independent and current; otherwise status remains NOT_CERTIFIED.

suites.name: Migration adapters, shadow traffic, merchant onboarding and go/no-go
suites.blocking_evidence: BLOCKED: approved migration shadow/canary, production merchant onboarding and Go/No-Go evidence are external and must be release-bound.

scenarios.steps: Run old/new adapter in shadow mode against replayed, non-mutating traffic.
scenarios.expected: Canonical diff is zero or explicitly approved; candidate has no provider side effects.

scenarios.steps: Onboard a synthetic merchant through KYB, capabilities, credentials and regional policy; execute the explicit ELMOS loopback checkout/refund integration test with a mounted test credential.
scenarios.expected: Four-eyes approval and rollback are recorded; loopback integration results are separate from provider-official evidence.

scenarios.steps: Review readiness checklist and Go/No-Go decision with owners.
scenarios.expected: All local gates pass and external evidence is present; otherwise blocked.

suites.name: Progressive delivery, post-launch reconciliation, commercial SLA and final certification
suites.blocking_evidence: BLOCKED: production shadow/canary, rollback drill, merchant acceptance, SLA/commercial approval and final independent certification are required.

scenarios.steps: Run a staged canary with ledger, duplicate-side-effect, latency, error and security thresholds.
scenarios.expected: Any threshold breach stops rollout and executes a tested rollback.

scenarios.steps: Perform post-launch monitoring, daily three-way reconciliation and commercial usage/SLA review.
scenarios.expected: No unexplained financial delta or unowned critical incident remains.

scenarios.steps: Collect provider certification, PCI/UAT/penetration, DR, merchant and independent review signatures.
scenarios.expected: Only then may B127 become certified; current default is 0/128 NOT_CERTIFIED.
